chapterInfo.content:
86
Ahohia kɛseɛ mu mpaebɔ
Dawid mpaebɔ.
1AWURADE, brɛ w’aso ase tie me,
na meyɛ mmɔborɔni ne ohiani.
2 # Dwom 18.20-26 Hwɛ me kra so, na meyɛ ɔhotefoɔ;
wo, me Nyankopɔn, gye w’abɔfra
a ɔde ne ho twere woɔ.
3 # Dwom 6.2 O AWURADE, hu me mmɔbɔ,
na wo na mesu mefrɛ wo da mu nyinaa.
4Ma w’akoa kra ani nnye,
na wo, AWURADE, na mema me kra so mema.
5 # Dwom 86.15 Na wo, AWURADE, woyɛ, na wode kyɛ,
na w’adɔeɛ dɔɔso ma wɔn a wɔfrɛ woɔ nyinaa.
6AWURADE, yɛ aso ma me mpaebɔ,
na tie me nkotosrɛ nne.
7 # Dwom 50.15 M’ahohia da mu mɛfrɛ wo,
na wobɛgye me so.
8 # Dwom 71.19 Obiara nte sɛ wo, anyame mu, AWURADE,
na biribiara nte sɛ wo nnwuma.
9Amanaman a woyɛeɛ nyinaa bɛba
abɛkoto w’anim, AWURADE,
na wɔabɛhyɛ wo din animuonyam.
10Na woyɛ kɛseɛ, na woyɛ anwanwadeɛ,
wo nkutoo ne Onyankopɔn.
11 # Dwom 27.11 AWURADE, kyerɛ me wo kwan,
mɛnante wo nokorɛ mu;
ka m’akoma bom ma no nsuro wo din.
12O AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn, mede m’akoma nyinaa bɛda wo ase,
na mahyɛ wo din animuonyam daa,
13sɛ w’adɔeɛ so wɔ me soɔ,
na woayi me kra afiri Asamando bunu mu.
14Onyankopɔn, ahantanfoɔ asɔre atia me,
na atirimuɔdenfoɔ asafo rehwehwɛ me kra,
na wɔamfa wo ansi wɔn ani so.
15 # Eks 34.6 Na wo, AWURADE, woyɛ Onyankopɔn mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔdomfoɔ,
wo boasetɔ kyɛ, na w’adɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ dɔɔso.
16 # Dwom 116.16 Dane w’ani kyerɛ me, na dom me,
fa w’ahoɔden ma w’akoa,
na gye w’afenaa ba nkwa.
17Yɛ me ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ma no nsi me yie,
na m’atamfoɔ nhunu, na wɔn ani nwu,
sɛ wo, AWURADE, woaboa me akyekyere me werɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
AWURADE, brɛ w’aso ase tie me,
na meyɛ mmɔborɔni ne ohiani.
Hwɛ me kra so, na meyɛ ɔhotefoɔ;
wo, me Nyankopɔn, gye w’abɔfra
a ɔde ne ho twere woɔ.
O AWURADE, hu me mmɔbɔ,
na wo na mesu mefrɛ wo da mu nyinaa.
Ma w’akoa kra ani nnye,
na wo, AWURADE, na mema me kra so mema.
Na wo, AWURADE, woyɛ, na wode kyɛ,
na w’adɔeɛ dɔɔso ma wɔn a wɔfrɛ woɔ nyinaa.
AWURADE, yɛ aso ma me mpaebɔ,
na tie me nkotosrɛ nne.
M’ahohia da mu mɛfrɛ wo,
na wobɛgye me so.
Obiara nte sɛ wo, anyame mu, AWURADE,
na biribiara nte sɛ wo nnwuma.
Amanaman a woyɛeɛ nyinaa bɛba
abɛkoto w’anim, AWURADE,
na wɔabɛhyɛ wo din animuonyam.
Na woyɛ kɛseɛ, na woyɛ anwanwadeɛ,
wo nkutoo ne Onyankopɔn.
AWURADE, kyerɛ me wo kwan,
mɛnante wo nokorɛ mu;
ka m’akoma bom ma no nsuro wo din.
O AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn, mede m’akoma nyinaa bɛda wo ase,
na mahyɛ wo din animuonyam daa,
sɛ w’adɔeɛ so wɔ me soɔ,
na woayi me kra afiri Asamando bunu mu.
Onyankopɔn, ahantanfoɔ asɔre atia me,
na atirimuɔdenfoɔ asafo rehwehwɛ me kra,
na wɔamfa wo ansi wɔn ani so.
Na wo, AWURADE, woyɛ Onyankopɔn mmɔborɔhunufoɔ ne ɔdomfoɔ,
wo boasetɔ kyɛ, na w’adɔeɛ ne wo nokorɛ dɔɔso.
Dane w’ani kyerɛ me, na dom me,
fa w’ahoɔden ma w’akoa,
na gye w’afenaa ba nkwa.
Yɛ me ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ma no nsi me yie,
na m’atamfoɔ nhunu, na wɔn ani nwu,
sɛ wo, AWURADE, woaboa me akyekyere me werɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
